import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    # First int is n (ignored)
    # Next 3 ints are a, next 3 are b
    a = list(map(int, data[1:4]))
    b = list(map(int, data[4:7]))
    min_val = max(0, a[0] - b[0] - b[2]) + max(0, a[1] - b[0] - b[1]) + max(0, a[2] - b[1] - b[2])
    max_val = min(a[0], b[1]) + min(a[1], b[2]) + min(a[2], b[0])
    print(f"{min_val} {max_val}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
